title: 第三章 天庭议会第四章 少龙主
content_zh:
远越高校里，应届年级的三班学们生正在体育馆里上飞剑课。
地板漆面清亮，器材完备。
在飞剑老师的教导下，学生始激活后颈里植入的智能芯片，辅助丹田气海里内的灵炁外放去牵引飞剑，完成挑、撩、斩、刺的动作。
这些飞剑并未开刃，属于教学用品的道具，复合木材质，拥有更容易被灵炁牵引的铭文回路，便于初学者操作。
只有对更高境界有追求的人，会选择完全古法运功，毕竟大多数人读书只为找个好工作，芯片脚本自动化就够了。
与其说是训练控剑，不如说是在增强学生和芯片之间的契合度。
但也有少部分学生还是会选择以传统的方式运功，
这类人被称为手搓怪，再智能的芯片与宿主也存在延时作用和指令偏差，更何况是在战况复杂的时候。
一般学生自然不需要考虑这些，如果想有更高成就，是必须要手搓的，芯片反而会干扰行动。
原身是相当偏执刻苦的人，哪怕天赋不高，也坚持用手搓，教材都是看纸质版，自身也有伪灵根，后颈没植入芯片。
似是自然演化，在方舱内的特殊生态环境下，具备灵根者占总人口的0.3%，已经是非常夸张的数字了。
方舱的教育是筛选式教育，生育也是筛选式，自然而然导致了这种现象。
王庆见周围一群学生有模有样的灵炁外放调律着飞剑，无形的真气隔空御物，颈后的芯片模块闪着红点，示意运作中。
他本人不敢表现得太扎眼，一板一眼的完成着动作。
已经还完了网贷，身上还有四十万块。
心中思虑着恐怖分子的事。
在方舱中，反恐部队是很神秘的单位，由方舱中央直接管理，地方无法干预办案，先斩后奏，横行霸道，堪称人上人上人。
而原身已经和魔道沾上关系了。
王庆去找过有自己所创功法的网站，但链接已经失效了，那些人为什么有自己的法门，怎么得来的，是否是自己麾下魔将所创的组织，依然还是一个谜。
只期待着那些人自己找上门来。

王庆早就碾碎了原身的元神，搜掠了所有记忆，原身上暗网时虽用过加密手段无痕浏览，但也不知道瞒不瞒得过网警。
反恐部队找上门很危险，那些家伙是装备了仙道战甲的，目前王庆也没亲眼见识过，只在短视频上刷到过，合金结构的全武装机甲相当酷炫，那是融合灵能工业所有尖端技术的巅峰产品，能让修真者的战力指数级增长，极为可怕。
通过短视频，饶是王庆都觉得这种战甲有些变态。
“不是哥们儿，我发现你是不是被夺舍了我操。”
刘子文芯片运功操纵着飞剑，向王庆搭话，这哥们儿半个月前突破了炼气三层，从吊车尾一下子干到了尖子生，上次月考到了年级前五十名，应届生可是有一千多号人，一下子追上几百名，这合理吗？
气场说不出来的古怪，光是看站姿就觉得他强得要命！加上人有点小帅，还装逼当手搓怪，太装了这个人。
“没错，我前世为修真界大能，遭小人陷害，轮回转世，转我五百，听我的复仇计划。”
王庆疯狂学习梗知识，就是为了伪装得更像本地人。
“别摆着一副冷漠的脸说出这么弱智的台词啊喂！你最近在刷哪个博主的视频，推荐一下！求求了！”
刘子文目光带着热忱，他留着碎发，颜值不算高，但也算干净，标准身材。
由于知识付费。
所有功法心法都要付钱，而学校里教的法门已经包含在学费里了。
也并不是教材版的就垃圾，教育集团里由专家搭配出的心法功法道术组合，比一般人瞎琢磨在网上乱买高到哪儿去了。
拥有法门的产权，才有混教育这一行的本钱。
除此之外。
想要免费修炼一些功法，也有路子。
那就是一些修真世家或是什么宗门武馆，拥有自己的独特法门，为了营收，往往会选择在短视频平台上开设账号，每天发视频教一些最初级的功法，想要进阶课程，还得是用钱去买，最次级的都要十万起跳，没有捡漏这一说。
电子版和纸质版的法门都有唯一序列号，非法传播，没有购买记录，侵犯知识产权，过检查时被逮到，或在工作时及其它场合使用被抓，是要吃官司坐大牢加巨额赔偿的。
刘子文所能想象到王庆这种吊车尾能快速变强的原因，肯定是刷到了良心博主，这些博主之间竞争也挺激烈的。
content_en:
In Yuanyue University, the third class of fresh-year students were taking flying sword classes in the gymnasium.
The floor paint is clear and the equipment is complete.
Under the guidance of Teacher Feijian, the students began to activate the smart chip implanted in the back of the neck to assist the spiritual energy in the Dantian Qi Sea to be released to pull the Feijian to complete the movements of picking, teasing, cutting and stabbing.
These flying swords are not sharpened and are teaching supplies. They are made of composite wood and have inscription circuits that are easier to be pulled by spiritual energy, making them easier for beginners to operate.
Only those who pursue a higher realm will choose to practice the ancient method completely. After all, most people study just to find a good job, and chip script automation is enough.
Rather than training sword control, it is better to enhance the fit between the student and the chip.
However, a small number of students still choose to exercise in traditional ways.
This kind of people are called hand rub monsters. No matter how smart the chip and host are, there are delays and command deviations, not to mention when the battle situation is complicated.
Ordinary students naturally don't need to think about this. If they want to achieve higher achievements, they must rub their hands. The chip will interfere with their actions.
He turns out to be a very paranoid and hard-working person. Even though he is not very talented, he still insists on rubbing with his hands. The textbooks are all printed on paper. He also has pseudo-spiritual roots and does not have a chip implanted in the back of his neck.
It seems to be natural evolution. In the special ecological environment of the cabin, people with spiritual roots account for 0.3% of the total population, which is already a very exaggerated figure.
The education in Fangcang is a screening education, and childbirth is also a screening type, which naturally leads to this phenomenon.
Wang Qing saw that a group of students around him were emitting decent spiritual energy and regulating the flying swords. The invisible energy was guarding objects in the air. The chip module behind the neck flashed a red dot, indicating that it was in operation.
He himself did not dare to act too conspicuous and completed his actions meticulously.
I have paid off the online loan and still have 400,000 yuan left.
I was thinking about the terrorists.
In the Fangcang, the anti-terrorism force is a very mysterious unit. It is directly managed by the center of the Fangcang. The local authorities cannot intervene in the handling of the case.
And the original body has already been related to the devil.
Wang Qing has looked for a website with the exercises he created, but the link has expired. Why those people have their own methods, how they got them, and whether they are organizations created by his demon generals are still a mystery.
I just expect those people to come to me on their own.
Wang Qing had already crushed the original soul and plundered all the memories. Although the original person had used encryption means to browse the darknet without trace, he didn't know if he could hide it from the Internet police.
It is very dangerous for anti-terrorist troops to come to your door. Those guys are equipped with fairy armor. Wang Qing has not seen it with his own eyes so far. He has only seen it in short videos. The fully armed armor with alloy structure is very cool. It is the pinnacle product that integrates all the cutting-edge technologies of the psychic industry. It can exponentially increase the combat power of cultivators, which is extremely terrifying.
Through the short video, even Wang Qing felt that this kind of armor was a bit abnormal.
"No dude, I'll fuck you if you were taken from me when I found out."
Liu Ziwen controlled the flying sword with his chip movement and talked to Wang Qing. This guy broke through the third level of Qi Refining half a month ago. He suddenly became a top student from the bottom of the crane. He passed the exam last month and was ranked among the top fifty in his grade. There are more than a thousand fresh graduates, and he has caught up with hundreds of them at once. Is this reasonable?
His aura is indescribably weird, and just by looking at his stance, I think he is extremely strong! In addition, he is a bit handsome, and he also pretends to be a hand rub monster. This person is too pretentious.
"That's right, I was a great master in the world of cultivation in my previous life. I was framed by a villain and reincarnated. I was reincarnated five hundred times and listened to my revenge plan."
Wang Qing studied memes like crazy in order to pretend to be more like a local.
"Don't say such stupid lines with a cold face! Hey! Which blogger's videos are you watching recently? Recommend them! Please!"
Liu Ziwen's eyes were full of enthusiasm. He had broken hair and a beautiful face.The value is not high, but it is clean and has a standard body shape.
Pay for knowledge.
All exercises and mental techniques must be paid for, and the methods taught in the school are already included in the tuition.
It’s not that the textbook version is rubbish. The combination of mental skills, exercises, and Taoist skills compiled by experts in the education group is much better than the average person’s random shopping online.
Only by owning the property rights of the method can we have the capital of mixed education.
besides.
If you want to practice some exercises for free, there are ways.
That is, some cultivation families or sect martial arts schools have their own unique skills. In order to make money, they often choose to open accounts on short video platforms and post videos every day to teach some of the most basic skills. If you want to advance, you have to spend money to buy advanced courses. The lowest level ones start at 100,000 yuan. There is no such thing as picking up the slack.
Both electronic and paper versions of the method have unique serial numbers. If they are illegally disseminated, have no purchase records, infringe on intellectual property rights, and are caught during inspection, or caught using them at work or other occasions, they will be prosecuted, jailed and paid huge amounts of compensation.
Liu Ziwen can imagine that the reason why Wang Qing, a crane tail, can become stronger quickly is because he has recruited conscientious bloggers, and the competition among these bloggers is also quite fierce.
